notes: the two «محمد بن الحسن» are two men with their own «حدثنا»: the father-figure of the compiler's chain and al-Saffar; they are not merged
«مسندا إلى أبي جعفر» names the Imam as the end of the chain inside the chain: narrator; «عليه السلام» and «رضي الله عنه» are left out; «2-45» is a number, not written
